name: gitlab-ci
description: A pane of your GitLab merge requests (pipelines, reviewers, what blocks the merge) and an inbox of reviews from mr-inbox; wakes a session when its MR's pipeline fails or finishes.

jiraUrl.title: Jira site
jiraUrl.description: Your Jira address, such as https://example.atlassian.net. Ticket keys in MR titles link there, and their details are read with Atlassian's acli when it is installed and signed in. Empty leaves Jira out.
